name: Cotton
read: Cotton Mar 27 options (on MAR 27 futures 80.92, 81 days to expiry 2027-02-05): at-the-money implied vol 21.7%, -1.9 pts vs 2026-11-10. 20-day realized vol 14.1%, so options trade at a premium of 7.6 pts. 25-delta risk reversal +3.5 (calls over puts). Over the last 10 sessions (2026-11-03 to 2026-11-16) call open interest fell 112,182 and puts fell 82,821; put/call OI 0.52 → 0.38, front futures 80.9 → 80.92. Delta-weighted, option holders added about +712 futures-equivalent lots in the last 5 sessions (net long exposure bought through options). Front ATM vol 22.2% → 18.6%. Largest Mar 27 strikes: 90 calls (7,757 lots) and 80 puts (3,093). Biggest 5-session builds: Mar 27 85 calls +1,131; May 27 90 calls +1,104. Biggest cut: Dec 27 80 calls -1,274.
